timeline.title: Read the final plan
timeline.do: The ~07:15 run is final (US close, Dow and US futures, Europe, Asia open). Read the expected open, bias and trades. Set price alerts at each entry and stop-loss.

timeline.title: Pre-open
timeline.do: Place no market orders. Note where your stocks are indicated to open.

timeline.title: Wait
timeline.do: Opening 15 min is the most volatile. Cancel any stock that opens above its T1 or below its SL.

timeline.title: Stock buy window
timeline.do: Buy only if price is holding above the entry and the 15-min opening high. Place the SL order immediately.

timeline.title: Options window
timeline.do: Spreads / ATM buys only if the index respects the support/resistance shown. Iron condor / fly only after 10:00 with the index inside the range.

timeline.title: Manage only
timeline.do: No new stock entries. If it did not trigger, skip it. Keep stop-loss orders in place.

timeline.title: Option buyers exit
timeline.do: Exit option buys by 15:00 if target not hit (time decay). Spreads/condors: hold only if still inside the plan.

timeline.title: Review
timeline.do: The engine grades today's plan. Check the Results tab: what worked, what the gap was.

timeline.title: Day 2: exit by 15:15
timeline.do: Book half at T1, trail SL to entry. Exit everything still open by 15:15 (this is a 1–2 day setup).

timeline.title: Expiry day
timeline.do: Do not hold short options into the last hour of expiry day.

golden_rules: Only grade A/B stocks. C = watch, don't trade.
Stop-loss order goes in the moment you buy. Never move it down.
Risk max 1% of capital per trade, max 3 open trades.
No trigger in the buy window = no trade. Missing a trade costs nothing.
If the app's live hit-rate (Learning tab) drops below its backtest, cut size in half.
